text:
catalyst-pm: Hi team — we're CatalySt PM. We want to onboard a legal summarizer model that digests contracts and outputs short lay summaries. Need it in our VPC, PHI'd docs excluded, but must handle contracts with PII. curious about PHI/PII handling and HSM for keys.
maya-cs: Thanks for the details. Quick Qs: target latency? concurrency? do you need realtime (<200ms) or nearline?
catalyst-pm: Latency isn't super strict, ~500ms p50 is fine. But throughput: 20 qps steady, spikes to 60 qps. Also strict retention: no logs saved by Redwood.
sam-cs: Noted. We'll need a private deployment then. I'll loop in eng/infra for HSM and retention controls.
jon-ml: On the model side, any constraints on instruction-following? Do you want redaction of names/SSNs automatically or just flagging?
catalyst-pm: Prefer automatic redaction for SSNs and bank accounts, but keep party names. Also need an explanation trace for any redaction decisions.
alondra-eng: For redaction + trace we can add a post-processing step that returns both summary and a redaction metadata blob. That will affect latency ~+40-60ms. Is that acceptable?
catalyst-pm: fine. Also want to run safety/regression evals on their test suite before rollback windows — Can Redwood run evals with our provided prompt bank?
maya-cs: Yes, we support custom eval sets. We'll coordinate upload of prompt bank and expected outputs. Do you have a baseline model in mind?
catalyst-pm: We were thinking rwd-13b-v1 quantized (if supported) or a 7B variant. Cost is a big factor.
jon-ml: We can host quantized variants on Dedicated. Need to check kernel support for rwd-13b-v1 Q4_K_M. Also note some quantization affects hallucination rates; we'll include quality regression checks.
evan-sec: Also need to confirm encryption at rest + KMS integration. HSM for key wrapping is doable but requires enterprise plan + paperwork.
legal-ops: CatalySt, please confirm whether contracts may include privileged/legal-advice-sections — that can trigger additional retention/audit controls.
catalyst-pm: Yes, some docs include litigation notes; we'd like an audit trail (who accessed, when) and ability to purge customer data.
sam-cs: We'll put together onboarding checklist: VPC request, KMS/HSM form, retention policy, prompt bank, sample documents (redacted). I'll open a private jira for tracking.
maya-cs: Heads-up: renewal risk flag — account currently in QBR cycle; onboarding delays could push renewal discussion. Let's aim for a pilot within 3 weeks.
catalyst-pm: 3 weeks is tight but ok for pilot. We can start with a 7B model and later upgrade.
alondra-eng: Deployment plan draft: 1) infra provisioning (VPC + HSM) 2) model build & quant test 3) eval run 4) canary in their VPC 5) go-live. ETA for infra + HSM: 7-10 business days once forms signed.
maya-cs: I'll schedule an enablement session (30m) for their engineers next Wed. Catalyst, what's the timezone?
catalyst-pm: We're PST. Wed morning PST works.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket CS-7412 for Catalyst private onboarding. Assignee: sam-cs.
sam-cs: I'll follow up with an intake doc and the HSM paperwork link. Will also ask for a minimal prompt set and 50 sample contracts for evals.
catalyst-pm: Sending the sample set now via secure upload. Also, can Redwood mask account numbers in outputs rather than redact fully? We need masked tokens like ACCT-XXXX1234.
alondra-eng: We can do deterministic masking with token preservation. We'll include examples in the canary.
evan-sec: One more: please confirm whether customers require SOC2 type controls mapping. If yes, legal-ops, can you prep the compliance packet?
legal-ops: On it — I'll assemble SOC2 + encryption + HSM attest docs and share with Catalyst.
maya-cs: Great. Next steps: sam will own intake, jon will own model compatibility, alondra will own redaction pipeline, evan/legal handle compliance. I'll keep weekly check-ins until pilot. :thumbsup:
sam-cs: Assigned. I'll post the intake doc link here when ready.
catalyst-pm: Thanks all — excited to get started. Appreciate the quick responses.
